Contact

This reference is maintained by e-mail. Corrections, additions and questions about a chapter are welcome.

E-mail: info@businessbrokerage.eu

What this site does not do

No businesses are listed, valued or brokered here. The site describes practice; it does not take mandates and does not act for buyers or sellers.

Corrections

Where a chapter no longer matches practice in a particular country, a short note with the relevant detail is enough for the page to be updated.
